modular_dim_zero.instructions: For target Serre levels N in {2, 6, 18}, is the dimension of the space of weight 2 cusp forms S_2(Gamma_0(N)) strictly zero, unconditionally precluding irreducible weight 2 modular representations?

criteria.true: Yes, dim S_2(Gamma_0(N)) = 0 for all N in {2, 6, 18}, so no such modular forms exist.
criteria.false: No, at least one of N in {2, 6, 18} has dim S_2(Gamma_0(N)) > 0.

conductor_reduction_soundness.instructions: Does the coprimality condition gcd(A, B, C) = 1 strictly guarantee that every odd prime p >= 5 dividing ABC has multiplicative reduction with nu_p(N) = 1, so that Ribet level-lowering removes all p >= 5 from the Serre level?

criteria.true: Yes, coprimality ensures multiplicative reduction at all p >= 5, so p does not divide the Serre level.
criteria.false: No, additive or non-minimal reduction can occur at p >= 5 even when gcd(A, B, C) = 1.
